blurb: Guests rent pontoon and tritoon boats on Lake Lewisville. Boats come with safety equipment and a full tank of gas. Rentals include access to water toys and amenities at the marina ship store.

quotes.author: Danielle Celmer-Yell
quotes.text: We've had a lot of issues with other shady boat rental places in the area, and we've lost a lot of faith in them until we started coming here! We've had zero issues, the boats are nice, staff is great and the location is simple to get to. I highly recommend this place! 5 STARS! The best part is gas is included, and apparently that doesn't happen at most places. This place has helped us restore our faith in boat rentals! MUST GO!

quotes.author: Sean Tremblay
quotes.text: Best pontoon boat rental we've had so far. While loading four little kids, I appreciated the staff for providing a rental form already filled in, and for getting us on the water quickly with life jackets of all sizes. We like that CCBR included fuel in the rental price, and an anchor for the boat. Great experience.

quotes.author: Richard Valle
quotes.text: Had an amazing time riding the wave runners. After the first hour the weather took a turn for the worst. The staff was extremely helpful and offered us a rain check for another day. Ryan made sure our experience was enjoyable and ensured we would return in the future.

quotes.author: Jeannea Hendrickson
quotes.text: Awesome service and friendly staff. I highly recommend and I am a lake person it was awesome. The rental fee includes the gas, which I have discovered is not the norm! Will definitely use again.

quotes.author: Jennifer Rivera
quotes.text: The rental process was very smooth and my family had an amazing time. It was clean and spacious. We will be returning soon and highly recommend this marina!

quotes.author: Michelle Prazak
quotes.text: Amazing experience!! This was our first time driving a boat and the team explained everything we needed to know. They were friendly and it was wonderful!
